authority_rule: The executable SQLite schema and its migration tests are higher authority than descriptive archive documentation. D1 introduced schema v2 without transferring runtime ownership; A2 now makes RustArchiver the production orchestrator and the crate-private ArchiveSyncRepository the sole canonical local SQLite write capability.

tables.archive_sync_runs: Sync-run lifecycle needed for later source-presence invalidation.
tables.classes: Preserved class entities with source_present/first_seen/last_seen lifecycle.
tables.students: Preserved student entities; class_id is deliberately absent.
tables.class_memberships: Many-to-many class/student membership and roster-specific state.
tables.tutorial_identities: Canonical tutorial-list API identities. tutorial_id is primary identity.
tables.tutorial_source_states: Normalized candidate historical tutorial states, independent of API identity ownership.
tables.tutorial_source_field_evidence: Minimal field-level source presence provenance; explicit blanks are representable without raw source blobs.
tables.tutorial_collision_groups: Same-timestamp collision groups with C3 collision classification.
tables.tutorial_collision_identities: Group-owned API identities for a collision.
tables.tutorial_collision_states: Group-owned candidate source states for a collision.
tables.tutorial_state_associations: Governed identity-to-state authority. Blocked statuses contain no source_state_id.
tables.scrape_log: Operational acquisition log retained for transitional compatibility.

identity_state_association.blocked_association_rule: Blocked authority statuses must persist source_state_id as NULL so no ambiguous candidate state is falsely attributed to a canonical tutorial_id.
identity_state_association.key_consistency_rule: Executable triggers require collision identities, collision states, and authoritative source_state_id associations to share the same student_uid/tutorial_ts reconciliation key as their owning identity/group.

source_presence.deletion_rule: A later source omission marks source_present false only after the relevant acquisition scope completes successfully; omission never deletes preserved historical rows.
source_presence.failed_sync_rule: Failed or rolled-back syncs must not invalidate prior source_present state. A completed full A2 run with authoritative class/roster/tutorial-list acquisition may invalidate truly disappeared identities even when auxiliary summary/print/edit evidence is partial; prior semantic source evidence is preserved for API tutorial keys still observed in that run.
source_presence.invalidation_guard: source_present may be set false only when presence_checked_run_id references archive_sync_runs.status=complete; failed/running runs cannot invalidate preserved presence.

foreign_keys.delete_policy: Preserved parent identities use RESTRICT; collision junction rows and per-identity authority rows may CASCADE only from their owning group/identity.

upsert_policy.required_pattern: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE/DO NOTHING
upsert_policy.reason: INSERT OR REPLACE can delete and recreate rows, breaking foreign keys, first_seen provenance, and identity stability.

raw_json_policy.migration_rule: Legacy raw_json is read only to extract minimal field-presence provenance and is never copied into the v2 destination database.
raw_json_policy.raw_html_policy: Raw summary/edit/print HTML remains private fixture evidence or ephemeral runtime data, not canonical archive state.
raw_json_policy.privacy_rule: The v2 migration must not retain legacy raw_json blobs or legacy email values.

legacy_v1_migration.class_membership_rule: Legacy students.class_id becomes one class_memberships row; no class_id column exists on v2 students.
legacy_v1_migration.unique_matched_tutorial_rule: A unique legacy tutorial with reconciliation_status=matched may migrate as proven_per_tutorial.
legacy_v1_migration.collision_rule: Any legacy duplicate same-timestamp group or reconciliation collision migrates as ambiguous_unknown with candidate states group-owned and no per-ID source_state_id.
legacy_v1_migration.unproven_rule: Legacy unmatched/unknown reconciliation migrates as unmatched_source_state with no source_state_id.
legacy_v1_migration.raw_json_rule: Discard after extracting minimal field-presence evidence.
legacy_v1_migration.failure_rule: Missing parent entities, collision IDs absent from tutorial identities, unrecognized schema shapes, or foreign-key violations fail migration and delete the incomplete destination.

views.tutorial_revision_state: Read model that always exposes identity and authority_status; source-state columns are NULL for blocked authority because the association table forbids false state attribution.

acceptance.offline_dependency_rule: tools/check_archive_schema.py must not import or execute the live-network Python v4.9 oracle. It verifies transitional class/student UPSERT behaviour by AST-extracting the exact SQL literals from TutorialDatabase and executing them against isolated SQLite using only Python stdlib dependencies.
